text_block_list.text:
Nice Nature's racing outfit had arrived, 
so she gave me an immediate look at how it 
suited her.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Personally, I think this outfit is pretty 
nice— not too flashy, not too plain."
choice_data_list: It's modest, but I think it's good.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Right? If the design's out of my league 
and the clothes end up wearing me, it just 
wouldn't look cool.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I packed everything I wanted to, so, yeah, 
I'd say it's good to go.

Hearing that, I took another look at Nice 
Nature's racing outfit.

Red and green—an outfit featuring ribbons 
and sleeves matching the color of the ear 
covers.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It might not really be my style, but 
it's the color of my memories.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: "...My mom raised me all on her own."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Working non-stop every single day for the 
sake of my daughter without taking any 
rest.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
That's why, back then, I tried not to be 
selfish so that I wouldn't become a 
burden.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Even so, Christmas was the one day where I 
could go back to being a kid.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I was foolish enough to honestly believe 
in Santa, so I wrote selfish wishes on the 
tree.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Saying, "I want to have a sparkling 
Christmas party with Mom!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
After that, Mom and all the regulars threw 
a Christmas party for me every year.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Turkey means yakitori, cake means snacks 
with drinks, and illumination means disco 
balls—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...It was far from ordinary, but it was a 
wonderful, sparkling Christmas.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my. Back then, I was so pure and had 
no idea who Santa really was!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Even the year I got accepted into Tracen 
Academy, they threw a Christmas party for 
me, you know—

text_block_list.name: Regular Customer A
text_block_list.text:
Look! It's your favorite party, Nei-chan! 
Old Santa gave it his all again this year♪

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Geez! Give me a break, stop bringing up 
childhood stuff!

text_block_list.name: Regular Customer B
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~? We old-timers were so happy when you 
said, "Everyone is Santa because you threw 
us a sparkly party," though?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ugh! I'm really sorry about that time...

text_block_list.name: Regular Customer B
text_block_list.text:
No, no, don't worry about it! Next time, 
it'll be my turn to have a wish granted!

text_block_list.name: Regular Customer C
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Seeing you out there shining 
on the track, Nei-chan... That's our only 
wish!

text_block_list.name: Regular Customer A
text_block_list.text:
"Aiming for the top! Once I get 1st place, 
let's all celebrate together again!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I had people congratulating me and all. 
Well, as you can see, this is how it 
turned out.
choice_data_list: It's not too late even now, you know.

text_block_list.text:
"I told Nice Nature that precisely because 
she felt that way, this must be what her 
racing outfit is for."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Haha... Goodness, I really am no match for 
you, Trainer.
choice_data_list:
Let's keep running carrying everyone's 
wishes!

That's the perfect racing outfit for Nice 
Nature!

It's the perfect racing outfit for Nice 
Nature!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Haha... Goodness, I really am no match for 
you, Trainer.
choice_data_list:
Let's keep running carrying everyone's 
wishes!

That's the perfect racing outfit for Nice 
Nature!

It's the perfect racing outfit for Nice 
Nature!

text_block_list.text:
Her mother and the regular customers who 
saw her off, as well as the people from 
the shopping district she met here.

Everyone is wishing for Nice Nature's 
victory. If so—
choice_data_list:
Let's become Santas who make everyone's 
wishes come true!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: S-Santa Claus, of all things, huh~.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I just hope the wishes she shoulders 
aren't so heavy that they weigh her down 
completely.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Whoa~, someone's feeling confident.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
If I'm Santa, does that make you the 
reindeer, Trainer? ...Hehe, want to try 
putting on a red nose?

"I'd rather have skipped the red nose if 
possible, but seeing how much fun Nice 
Nature was having, I figured it was worth 
it."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Haah, is that so. How should I put 
it... yeah.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I'm delighted to hear that it suits your 
taste, Trainer. Haha.

Though she gave a playful, teasing reply, 
her expression looked somehow happy.
choice_data_list:
Let's have a race that's just like 
Christmas!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Christmas?
choice_data_list: A sparkling run that delivers happiness!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Sparkly, huh... I wonder if I can really 
pull that off~

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...Well, might as well give it a shot. I 
owe a debt to everyone and Trainer-san, 
after all."

The day when everyone's wishes can come 
true isn't far off. —Looking at her in her 
racing racewear, I truly felt that way.
